text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν κόρακα ἐκ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
objects: a blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Hyperbrephos drags Korax by the wing toward the edge of the frame
Korax is being pulled along reluctantly, squawking and looking annoyed
The four animal friends watch with relief as the troublemaker is removed
Dinosaur, Panda, Koala, and Glaux all have hopeful expressions returning to their faces
The blue-and-white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies on the ground nearby
